column1: # The role-parity NUDGE (`task nudge:roles`, api/cmd/roleparity) compares this
# repo's dev-team roster (.claude/agents/*.md) against the product builtin roster
# (api/internal/agenttmpl/builtins/*.md). A role on one side and absent from the
# other is a divergence worth NOTICING — a nudge, never a gate. Roles listed here
# are known-and-accepted divergences the nudge stays quiet about.
#   side   = product-only | devteam-only  (which roster the role is in)
#   role   = the role identity (the .md filename stem)
#   reason = why this divergence is accepted (documentation for humans)
